translation.spanish: que aquéllos ignorantes que mal provocan a los Santos, no viven en Paz.

english.default: The Saints seek to bless them with virtue, but they are burning with egotism.

translation.spanish: Los Santos buscan bendecirlos con mérito, pero llenos de necedad, se queman en el fuego de su ego.

english.default: What can those wretched ones do? Their evil destiny was pre-ordained.
